scalar_angular_codec.preprocess: token RMS normalize, then block-Hadamard rotate
scalar_angular_codec.shared_clip: per-layer native-calibration q0.995 absolute rotated normalized coordinate; same clip reused for A4/A3/A2, no rate-specific tuning
scalar_angular_codec.decode: inverse Hadamard then deterministic unit-RMS renormalization before multiplying by the separately coded radius

radial_codec.type: 4-bit uniform scalar quantization of log RMS
radial_codec.calibration: candidate-specific cascaded calibration on the same frozen 256 calibration tokens only; each layer range is frozen from the trajectory produced by already-quantized upstream layers under that same directional codec

vq_codec.distance: Euclidean nearest-codeword in rotated normalized 4-D groups
vq_codec.decode: inverse Hadamard then deterministic unit-RMS renormalization before multiplying by radius

synthetic_primary.optimizer: deterministic k-means++ initialization plus 8 Lloyd iterations
synthetic_primary.shared: one codebook reused across all layers

calibration_hostile_control.training_data: 2048 deterministic sampled rotated normalized 4-D groups per layer from native calibration trajectories, pooled across layers
calibration_hostile_control.optimizer: deterministic k-means++ initialization plus 8 Lloyd iterations
calibration_hostile_control.shared: one codebook reused across all layers

vq_codec.codebook_storage: 256 x 4 float32 values = 4096 bytes per codebook; report separately as amortized metadata

phase1_conditions: matched Hadamard dynamic per-token absmax A4
scalar angular A4 + cascaded log4 radius
scalar angular A3 + cascaded log4 radius
scalar angular A2 + cascaded log4 radius
synthetic-codebook grouped VQ A2 + cascaded log4 radius
calibration-kmeans grouped VQ A2 + cascaded log4 radius
synthetic-codebook grouped VQ A2 + exact radius
conditional_shift_control: After phase1, evaluate the preregistered shifted-radius negative control for the best frozen A2 code. If A3 is the best/only sub-4 candidate and differs from the best A2 code, also evaluate shifted-radius A3 so the sub4-success rule has its required causal control. Selection uses only the already-preregistered best-candidate rule and does not alter any codec parameters.

decision_rules.sub4_success: At least one A3/A2 condition has NLL < matched dynamic A4 and is >=0.25 NLL better than its shifted-radius control.
decision_rules.a2_scalar_success: scalar A2 + log4 radius NLL < matched dynamic A4 NLL
decision_rules.a2_vq_success: best frozen A2 VQ + log4 radius NLL < matched dynamic A4 NLL
decision_rules.representation_generalization: both scalar-A2 and VQ-A2 beat matched dynamic A4
decision_rules.vq_preemption: best VQ-A2 beats scalar-A2 by >=0.10 NLL
decision_rules.stop: if neither A3 nor A2 beats matched dynamic A4, park sub-4-bit claims and retain A4 representation result only

prohibitions: Do not call the residual VQ adaptation NSNQuant proper.
Do not claim novelty for shape-gain decomposition.
